✨ 6 Skincare Ingredients That Actually Work Skin concerns can feel confusing, but choosing the right ingredient makes it much easier 👀 Blackheads → BHA Oily skin → Niacinamide Dry skin → Ceramide Closed comedones → Adapalene Wrinkles → Retinal Acne → Azelaic acid BHA can help with blackheads and clogged pores, niacinamide is often used for oily skin support, ceramides help support dry skin and the skin barrier, adapalene is commonly used for closed comedones, retinal can help with smoother-looking fine lines, and azelaic acid is often used for acne-prone skin. Some ingredients, like adapalene or retinal, may not be suitable for everyone, so use them carefully and ask a pharmacist or dermatologist if you’re unsure. finally did a skincare routine 🦦💗 this is just what i use and it might not work for everyone! i found the best way to treat my acne and other skin issues was learning more about my skin (my skin type, what kind of acne with my dermatologist) and my biggest piece of advice for anyone who is dealing with skin issues: it’s not permanent and things take time! a pimple can take 1-2 weeks to form and a few more to go away and a lot of products take just as long to show results. i learned to normalize acne/skin issues because everyone goes through them and that’s helped my anxiety/stress when it comes to how my skin looks so much. i’ll probably make another video about how i desensitized myself to my skin issues and how important that is 🤍 i just started up tretinoin a month ago at 0.025% twice a week and my skin has been incredibly dry but i think i’ve finished most of the purging 🙂 excited to see more results from it! products 🪽: @mixsoon_official bean cleansing oil + centella cleansing foam @anua.skincare_us toner pads @mediheal_official tea tree toner pads @Pyunkang Yul (편강율) essence toner @imfrom_global mugwort essence @apieu.official madecassoside cream 2x tretinoin 0.025% (prescription) @Kiehl’s Since 1851 avocado eye cream @Laniege_us lip sleeping mask #skincare #skincareroutine #skincareproducts #koreanskincare #asianskincare #koreanskincareroutine #koreanskin #glassskin #acnetreatment
